info.description: Friendly NWS weather with local GeoNames city lookup. MCP at /mcp uses Streamable HTTP, not REST. GET and HEAD on /v1/* and /openapi.json send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (public, read-only, no credentials), so browser clients on any origin can call the API. Responses carry Cache-Control: complete reports are public with max-age and s-maxage equal to the remaining life of their oldest upstream source (at most 120 s); 400/404/409 errors are public, max-age=60; city search is public, max-age=86400; reports with alertsStatus unavailable or a partial-source warning, 422 and 5xx errors are no-store.
